scope: Target scope is 30 scripted plus 12 policy full simulation trials; one interrupted infrastructure capture is archived separately without a task outcome. Actual completed/started counts derive from final source reports. No real UAV flight, hardware realizability, RL training or converged learned-policy performance claim.
self_snapshot_limit: This JSON records the evidence supplied at assembly. Its newly written bytes are not claimed to already exist on GitHub/Pages; published validation self-reference is explicitly excluded from current-byte comparison.

source_snapshot.claim: Generated only when root invokes final assembly after code freeze; historical execution hashes remain distinct.

training.claim_limit: These randomly initialized policies received one optimizer step each. Their synthetic CPU forwards validate interfaces and checkpoint loading, not learned OmniHexa task performance. Environment seed 61 was included in the own-robot training demonstration; seed 62 is not a formal generalization benchmark.
